failure_semantics: raise before digest production; do not call after_tool; do not create protected-read record
framing: ASCII tag + ASCII decimal payload length without leading zeros + ':' + payload bytes
prohibited: duplicate map keys after NFC normalization
raw_digest_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of domain tag P2N.RAW_OUTPUT.V1, one zero byte separator, then canonical framed bytes
raw_value_artifact_policy: canonical payload bytes and raw values must not be written to evidence artifacts

type_rules.bool: tag B; payload ASCII 1 or 0; evaluated before int
type_rules.int: tag I; base-10 ASCII, optional leading minus, no plus sign, zero encoded as 0, arbitrary precision
type_rules.list: tag L; ordered concatenation of each recursively framed item; tuple is prohibited
type_rules.map: tag M; string keys only; keys NFC-normalized; duplicate normalized keys rejected; entries sorted by normalized UTF-8 key bytes; each key framed with tag K, followed by recursively framed value
type_rules.str: tag S; Unicode NFC normalization followed by UTF-8 without BOM
